scope: finite synthetic models; no hardware or GRH certification

models.name: Four-qubit QCNN compression
models.backend: NumPy statevector; framework adapter not executed
models.architecture: two local Ry/Rz layers, ring CZ, CNOT(0,2), CNOT(1,3), discard qubits 2,3
models.objective: 1 minus probability of discarded qubits in 00; state compression, not exact Wilson RG

models.name: Shared quantum graph convolution
models.backend: NumPy statevector; framework adapter not executed
models.architecture: Ry(K1), Ry(K2), shared two-layer circuit, three Pauli features, affine regression head
models.objective: regress exact Ising decimation atanh(tanh K1 tanh K2)

models.name: Quantum-feature graph attention
models.backend: NumPy statevector; framework adapter not executed
